intended_object: An auxiliary quantity used in the proof of the quantum adversary lower bound. For a query index o, it is Σ_x ‖δ_x · P_o ψ_x‖², the total squared norm of the δ-weighted state family after projecting onto the sector o of the query register (some i, or none). This is inferred from the docstring, the "query step" section and its use in the progress-change lemmas.
